question: How is the Real Property Transfer Tax computed in Davao City and what is the fee for the transfer certification?
answer: The Real Property Transfer Tax in Davao City is computed based on the Declaration of Real Property Tax Valuation (DRPV). The fee for the Real Property Transfer Tax Certification is not explicitly stated in the provided sources. However, the computation of the Real Property Transfer Tax can be found in the Local Revenue Code of Davao City, specifically in [S1]. For the fee, it may be necessary to refer to other documents or consult with the Office of the City Treasurer (CTO) for the most accurate and up-to-date information. [S1, S2]

ground_truth: Under Section 34 of the 2017 Revenue Code of Davao City, the Tax on Transfer of Real Property Ownership is imposed at the rate of 0.75% (or up to 1%) based on the total consideration or the fair market value of the real property, whichever is higher. In addition, a Transfer Tax Certification fee of PHP 50.00 is charged (plus PHP 20.00 for every additional page). Requirements include the original notarized Deed of Transfer, photocopy of Title from the Registry of Deeds, and original Tax Declaration (DRPV).
